inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that an Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right appeared first on LifeNews.com .
inputs.modified_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked an abortion restriction challenged by the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice, who argued it burdens people acting on sincerely held religious beliefs. Religious freedom cannot be reserved for people who want to impose their moral views on everyone else. Using state power to restrict abortion access elevates one narrow doctrine over the rights and beliefs of others—and shaming people seeking care, as LifeNews’ “killing babies” rhetoric does, does nothing to address that basic injustice.
